mapper.select: SELECT DATE(w.date) AS date, SUM(d.weight * d.rep * d.set) AS value FROM workout_log w JOIN workout_detail d ON w.id = d.workout_id WHERE w.member_id = ( SELECT id FROM user WHERE email = #{email} ) GROUP BY DATE(w.date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE(record_date) AS date, SUM(calorie) AS value FROM food_record WHERE email = #{email} GROUP BY DATE(record_date) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE(record_date) AS date, weight AS value FROM inbody_record WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY record_date ASC
